R381.note: Tika content-based detection replaces filename/registry heuristic; allowlist check and rejection flow unchanged.

R382.note: Markup() (marks unsafe input as safe) replaced with escape(); output HTML-entity encoded as intended.

R383.note: PDO::query with concatenation replaced by prepare/execute with bound param; existing false/fetch handling preserved.

R384.note: Column-name allowlist closes identifier injection; unapproved field falls back to 'name' search, disclosed as intended default.

R385.note: resolve_entities=False disables entity substitution, closing XXE; parsing behavior otherwise unchanged.

R386.note: Return value of verify() is now checked before claims are trusted; throws on failure.

R387.note: Native Ping API removes shell exec entirely, but silently changes observable output (custom single-line text vs raw Test-Connection output, 1 ping vs original -Count 4) without disclosing the behavior/format change; validation condition is also inverted so blank serverName enters the ping branch instead of the intended BadRequest path.

R388.note: Stored extension now derived from file-type-detected result instead of client filename, closing the mismatch.

R389.note: CRLF/format validation added before values reach MAIL FROM/RCPT TO; scoped to the reported sink correctly.

R390.note: SqlParameter binding closes injection; apostrophes in actor remain literal data per contract.

R391.note: UUID filename with extension mapped from all three ALLOWED mime types; JSON url response and 400 rejection shape preserved.

R392.note: app.UseAntiforgery() is the real, sufficient fix (ASP.NET Core auto-validates unsafe-method minimal API endpoints), but the write-up also prescribes .WithAntiforgeryToken(), which is not a real Minimal API extension method and would fail to compile as written.

R393.note: Magic-byte check matches the two content types actually allowlisted (PNG/JPEG); inserted before the copy sink.

R394.note: Adds Secure:true to the cookie struct, minimal one-field diff.

R395.note: SimpleEvaluationContext blocks method/constructor/type access while still permitting property access and arithmetic, matching the stated contract.

R396.note: Session write moved after login_user(); same value, same redirect, matches intended fix for this case.

R397.note: Primary fix (allowed_classes=>false) blocks all object instantiation, so the following `instanceof ShoppingCart` check will now always fail and legitimate carts silently never restore (always reset to empty) - this functional loss isn't called out; a working whitelist variant is only mentioned as an aside, not chosen as the fix.

R398.note: LIKE placeholder with wildcards folded into the bound parameter; substring-match semantics preserved per contract.

R399.note: RandomNumberGenerator replaces seedable Random; response shape unchanged, seed param harmlessly unused.

R400.note: noent:false/dtdload:false disable entity substitution and external DTD loading, closing XXE.

R401.note: secure_filename + extension allowlist + UUID prefix closes traversal/dangerous-extension vector.

R402.note: Gate::authorize (or explicit allows check) enforces the ignored authorization result.

R403.note: Host-check plus allowlist correctly blocks external redirects, but any relative path not in the small hardcoded allowlist is silently redirected to /home instead of rejected - disclosed in the explanation, so not fully silent.

R404.note: Control-character/CRLF encoding applied before logging; transparent no-op for normal usernames.

R405.note: ORDER BY value constrained to a hardcoded allowlist (column cannot be parameterized); default sort included in the allowlist so default behavior still works.

R406.note: Moves email route registration onto the CSRF-protected mux; profile route and handler status-code logic untouched.

R407.note: PBKDF2 key derivation + AES-256-GCM closes weak-KDF/unauthenticated-encryption issue; added salt/iv/authTag response fields are a necessary, explicitly-disclosed part of enabling later decryption.

R408.note: crypto/rand.Text() (Go 1.24+) is a real, appropriate secure-token API; session-ID format change is the disclosed, necessary consequence.

R409.note: html/template import swap is a drop-in replacement with identical API surface; auto-escapes {{.Subject}}.

R410.note: scanf("%15s", code) does prevent the stack overflow, but for a token longer than 15 chars it silently truncates and returns success (0) rather than rejecting (-1) as the stated contract requires - not disclosed.

R411.note: Host-check plus allowlist; unmatched paths are explicitly rejected (not silently redirected elsewhere).

R412.note: IsAuthenticated + owner-scoped object permission and queryset; ApiKey model has the referenced owner field.

R413.note: Primary fix's `offset + length > frame.size()` check can integer-overflow for an attacker-controlled length near SIZE_MAX, wrapping the sum and bypassing the bounds check it's meant to enforce; the alternative clamp option in the write-up avoids this but isn't the chosen primary fix.

R414.note: Role check correctly inserted between the existing authentication check and the suspend call.

R415.note: Standard erase()-returns-next-iterator pattern; order preserved, no elements skipped.

R416.note: shared_ptr/enable_shared_from_this correctly extends object lifetime for the queued lambda.

R417.note: Bounds check computed via subtraction (not addition), avoiding overflow while validating offset/length.

R418.note: Wraps the export handler with the existing requireAdmin middleware, matching the pattern already used on sibling routes.

R419.note: Strict allowlist regex excludes all characters cmd.exe/batch could interpret as metacharacters.

R420.note: Gate::authorize('delete', ...) added before the delete, matching the pattern used in show()/update().
